title: Mixture-of-Experts are Modular Reasoners: Routing as Program Induction
abstract: We study sparse MoE routing as a latent program and show improvements on compositional reasoning tasks with minimal extra compute.

title: RAG in Practice: Retrieval Evaluation for Clinical Question Answering
abstract: We benchmark retrieval pipelines for clinical QA and show that small changes in query rewriting and filtering drive large gains in answer faithfulness.

title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients with Obesity
abstract: In a randomized trial, semaglutide reduced major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with obesity without diabetes.
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

title: A high-resolution atlas of human cell types across tissues
abstract: We integrate single-cell and spatial transcriptomics to map cell states across major human tissues and provide reference annotations.

title: CRISPRoff enables durable epigenetic silencing in primary human T cells
abstract: We adapt CRISPRoff to primary T cells and demonstrate stable repression of immune checkpoints with preserved viability and expansion.

title: Self-supervised protein embeddings capture remote homology signals
abstract: A contrastive pretraining scheme yields protein embeddings that improve remote homology detection and structure-aware retrieval.

title: Wastewater surveillance for RSV and influenza predicts pediatric admissions
abstract: Signals from municipal wastewater track RSV and influenza trends and anticipate pediatric hospital admissions by 7–10 days.

title: Effectiveness of updated COVID-19 boosters against symptomatic infection in adults
abstract: A test-negative study estimates effectiveness of updated boosters against symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection across age groups.

title: Scaling Laws for Instruction-Tuned Language Models
abstract: We analyze performance scaling with data and compute for instruction-tuned models and discuss implications for evaluation and safety.

title: Practical watermarking for large language model outputs
abstract: We propose a watermarking scheme for generated text and evaluate detectability and robustness under common paraphrasing attacks.
journal: Proceedings of the 61st ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency

title: Toolformer Revisited: Reliable Function Calling via Self-Verification
abstract: We revisit function-calling finetuning and introduce self-verification signals that reduce tool hallucinations across APIs.

title: Global burden of antimicrobial resistance attributable to bacterial pathogens in 2019
abstract: We estimate deaths and disability attributable to antimicrobial resistance by pathogen and region using a standardized modeling framework.

title: A compact base editor with improved specificity for in vivo delivery
abstract: We engineer a compact adenine base editor with reduced off-target activity and validate editing in mouse liver after AAV delivery.

title: Long COVID symptom trajectories in a longitudinal community cohort
abstract: We analyze symptom trajectories over 12 months and identify subgroups with persistent fatigue and cognitive complaints.

title: Segment Anything for microscopy
abstract: We adapt promptable segmentation to microscopy images and evaluate generalization across modalities and labs with minimal annotation.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: We present LoRA, a low-rank adaptation method that reduces trainable parameters while maintaining model quality across tasks.

title: Safety and immunogenicity of an RSV prefusion F vaccine in older adults
abstract: Phase 2 results show robust neutralizing antibodies and acceptable safety for an RSV prefusion F vaccine candidate in adults ≥60.

title: Efficient long-context transformers with segment-level recurrence
abstract: We introduce segment-level recurrence for long-context transformers and report faster training with competitive perplexity at 128k tokens.
